# KNETIX

> KNETIX builds done-for-you loyalty, referral, booking, and SMS systems for local service businesses across Canada.

## Product

- [KNETIX](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/): Fully branded loyalty and referral systems for local shops, with customer rewards and no app to download.
- [KNETIX Loyalty](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/loyalty.html): A branded loyalty and referral system built for the business, live in 24 hours, with QR signup and no app to download.

## Rep Program

- [KNETIX Rep Program](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/rep.html): Get certified free, close local businesses, work remotely, and start with no experience.

## Company

- [About KNETIX](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/about.html): KNETIX is run by Mohamad Aldossari from Edmonton, Alberta, serving shops across Canada.

## Blog

- [KNETIX Blog](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/blog.html): Guides on customer loyalty, referrals, repeat revenue, and building an income as a KNETIX sales rep.
- [How to Get Repeat Customers for Your Detailing Business](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/get-repeat-detailing-customers.html): How detailing shops build repeat customers and referrals that stick.
- [How to Get Nail Clients to Keep Coming Back](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/keep-nail-clients-coming-back.html): How nail techs and salons keep clients loyal, rebooking, and referring without slashing prices.
- [How to Make Money in Sales With No Experience](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/make-money-in-sales-no-experience.html): How commission sales works, what makes people good at it, and how to start from zero.
- [How to Get Barber Clients to Come Back Every Time](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/get-barber-clients-to-come-back.html): How barbers keep clients coming back on schedule without discounting a single cut.
- [How Vape Shops Build Repeat Customers](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/vape-shop-repeat-customers.html): How vape and smoke shops turn drop-in buyers into regulars without cutting prices.
- [Is Commission-Only Sales Worth It?](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/is-commission-only-sales-worth-it.html): An honest breakdown of when commission-only sales is worth it and when it is not.
- [How to Sell to Local Businesses](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/how-to-sell-to-local-businesses.html): A practical playbook for selling to barbershops, salons, and local shops.
- [What Happens When a Local Shop Runs a Loyalty Program](https://www.knetixmarketing.com/what-happens-when-a-shop-runs-a-loyalty-program.html): What happens when local shops run loyalty programs, including what works and what owners do not expect.
